title: Push CGM data to Diabetes:M app
symptom: The issue requests a feature to push CGM data from xDrip to the Diabetes:M app, but the effort was abandoned because the Diabetes:M app will not display data points closer than 15 minutes apart, making it useless for CGM data.
cause: The Diabetes:M app and its developers refuse to display data points closer than 15 minutes apart, which is unacceptable for CGM data.
fix: No fix was implemented; the issue was closed by the author due to the Diabetes:M app's limitation and lack of cooperation from its developers.
evidence_quote: I abandoned this project for the simple reason that the diabetes:m crew/app won't allow data closer than 15 minutes to be used or displayed. That makes the diabetes:m app useless for CGM data.
